name: banco-imagenes
description: Banco de Imágenes — app interna (frontend React + backend Node en un solo proceso)

scripts.postinstall: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
